metadata.title: Factors predicting mathematics achievement in PISA: a systematic review

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values handling is not applicable because this paper does not estimate PISA mathematics achievement from student-level plausible values; it synthesizes results from previously published studies.
design_fields.q2_rationale: This study is a systematic literature review and does not conduct a new student-level analysis of PISA microdata, thus there is no application of PISA sampling weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, as it is a systematic review of existing literature.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any validation strategies such as cross-validation or external validation, nor does it provide information on validation beyond the estimation sample.
